reflector.center_reference: deepest recessed foil point; operator-confirmed 1.00 m antenna-to-center distance
reflector.support: stacked cardboard boxes, added after baseline
reflector.other_clutter: printed fiducial on cardboard behind and above foil, dimensions/position not surveyed
reflector.association_scope: entire newly added target assembly, not foil-only

comparison_conditions.baseline: new clean absent scene; foil and support boxes absent
comparison_conditions.reflector: foil + newly added boxes + marker/cardboard; joint association only
comparison_conditions.planned_post_removal: superseded: marker is attached to foil and was removed with it
comparison_conditions.post_removal: support boxes retained unchanged; foil and attached marker/cardboard removed together; operator stepped clear
comparison_conditions.cleared: all added objects removed: foil, attached marker/cardboard and support boxes; original scene unchanged

removal.timestamp_basis: approximate acknowledgement receipt; operator did not note exact second

final_clear.removed: all remaining stacked support boxes; foil and marker already removed
